name: voice-ai
description: Voice AI — cloud audio-transcription platform. Monorepo: serverless AWS backend + Nuxt frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run offline --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.deploy:frontend:dev: npm run generate --workspace frontend && aws s3 sync frontend/.output/public s3://voice-ai-web-dev --delete
